name: Text S.A.
summary: Text S.A. is a worldwide developer and distributor of communication software solutions tailored for businesses. Its product portfolio includes LiveChat, a tool facilitating direct interactions between website visitors and owners; ChatBot, designed for creating conversational AI agents to automate customer support and corporate communications; KnowledgeBase, a platform that allows companies to build extensive information repositories for both employees and clients; and HelpDesk, an application aimed at streamlining email-based customer service workflows for teams. Founded in 2002, the company underwent a name change in September 2023, evolving from LiveChat Software S.A. to its current designation, Text S.A. It is based in Wroclaw, Poland.
